identityProvider.title: Identity providers
identityProvider.description: Let people sign in with their work account: OIDC services such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra ID and Okta, or SAML 2.0 services such as ADFS. The email domain decides which connection is used.
identityProvider.callbackUrl: Redirect URI to register with the identity provider

hint.name: Shown on the sign-in button, e.g. “Acme Azure AD”.
hint.issuer: OIDC issuer URL; endpoints are read from /.well-known/openid-configuration.
hint.clientSecret: Write-only: it is never shown again after saving.
hint.clientSecretKeep: Leave empty to keep the current secret.
hint.domains: People with these email domains see this connection after entering their email. A domain can belong to only one connection.
hint.protocolLocked: The protocol can't be changed after creation. Create a new connection instead.
hint.entityId: The IdP's identifier (entityID in its metadata). Changing it unlinks every connected user.
hint.ssoUrl: Where the IdP receives AuthnRequests (HTTP-Redirect binding).
hint.certificates: X.509 certificates (PEM) the IdP signs assertions with. During rotation you can register both, up to 3.
hint.nameIdFormat: NameID identifies the person. Persistent is recommended: an email NameID stops matching once the email changes.
hint.emailAttribute: Leave empty to look for common names (emailaddress claim, mail); otherwise an email-format NameID is used.

policy.autoCreateHint: Accounts are only created for the domains registered above.

remove.title: Delete identity provider
remove.confirm: Delete “{{name}}”? Its domains are released and linked people can no longer sign in with it; domains set to SSO only can sign in with a password again.

error.issuerInvalid: Enter a full URL that matches the selected service

identityProvider.samlAcsUrl: ACS URL to register in the SAML IdP (Assertion Consumer Service)
identityProvider.spEntityId: SP entity ID (also the SP metadata URL the IdP can import)

presetHint.generic: Any service with OIDC discovery. Only emails with email_verified true are used to match existing accounts.
presetHint.google: Only organization-managed Workspace accounts (hd in the ID token) are matched by email or auto-created; consumer Gmail accounts are not.
presetHint.microsoft: Only single-directory endpoints are accepted. Entra doesn't send email_verified: add the optional claim "xms_edov" to the app registration to match existing accounts by email.
presetHint.okta: Your Okta org URL (https://<org>.okta.com) or a custom authorization server (…/oauth2/<id>).

metadata.applied_one: Filled in the entity ID, SSO URL and {{count}} certificate
metadata.applied_other: Filled in the entity ID, SSO URL and {{count}} certificates

error.noRedirectBinding: The IdP doesn't offer an HTTP-Redirect SSO URL
